card.name: The word events after "such" in NSAID warning
card.fires_on: The word "events" right after "such" in the NSAID cardiovascular warning sentence about physicians and patients staying alert for the development of such events.

modes.label: Alert for such events
modes.description: The word "events" ends the phrase "remain alert for the development of such" in the NSAID class warning.
modes.example: Physicians and patients should remain alert for the development of such<< events>>, throughout the entire treatment course, even

card.plain: It lights up on the word "events" in the standard NSAID warning telling doctors and patients to watch for such events.
